segments.text: Why does the new iPhone camera have... blades?
The iPhone 18 Pro main camera has a variable aperture:
six tiny blades that open and close,
like the pupil of your eye.
Each blade is barely a millimeter wide at the tip,
Wide open, it lets in about seven times more light.
Closed down, more of the picture stays sharp.
the Galaxy S9 had two apertures in 2018.
segments.say: the Galaxy S nine had two apertures in twenty eighteen.

segments.text: If one blade gets stuck, you replace the whole camera.
During iFixit's teardown, a blade flew away.
Somewhere out there, a blade is free.
